polityNote: People’s Republic / Republic of Mozambique from independence on 1975-06-25 (colonial districts 1954-1975 are in MOZ-distritos-1954.json). Atoms: geoBoundaries MOZ ADM2 (INE / OCHA ROSEA 2019, 159 districts incl. the city districts and Lago Niassa, CC BY 3.0 IGO). Province/district = union of present districts (gb ADM1 is OSM/Wambacher and does not nest; membership is INE’s, the best ADM1 overlap of every district agrees). Two gb atoms (Ilha Licom = Likoma, Ilha Risunodo = Chizumulu) are Malawian islands and are named outside. Rewritten from ne-admin1 to gb-adm2 (2026-10-06): the NE Maputo city atom (~100 km²) lacked KaTembe and Inhaca; the gb city atom (348 km²) contains both (point tests) and matches the municipal area 346.77 km². (1) Unions vs INE areas (statoids): Gaza -0.2%, Sofala -0.1%, Tete +0.3%, Inhambane +0.5%, Niassa (with lake) +0.6%, Manica +1.4%, Zambézia -1.5%; the coastal Nampula -3.9%, Cabo Delgado -5.4% and Maputo province+city -10.2% are short with no neighbour correspondingly long, i.e. INE counts coastal water/islands the atoms omit, not a different land line. The CC0 regions panel (DVN/BM4WW0) has the same ten provinces from 1975.
